title: Polymarket hits $1B in trading volume as prediction markets gain mainstream attention
author: technologist42

top_comments.author: marketwatcher
top_comments.text: The growth is driven largely by election markets. I've been tracking the AI regulation contracts — they're surprisingly liquid given how niche the topic is.

top_comments.author: quantresearcher
top_comments.text: Prediction markets are the most honest signal we have for geopolitical risk. The Polymarket contracts on the Russia-Ukraine situation were pricing in the invasion weeks before mainstream media acknowledged it.

top_comments.author: geopoliticsnerd
top_comments.text: The regulatory risk in the US is real. CFTC has been watching these closely. Any offshore-only model is going to hit a ceiling once institutional capital starts flowing in seriously.
